name: s3Write
syntax: s3Write(bucketName, objectName, value [, charset, mimeType, acl, location, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, host, timeout])
description: Writes a value to an object in an S3 bucket.

params.name: value
params.description: A string, a binary, or a file object from `fileOpen()`.

params.name: mimeType
params.description: The MIME type of the value.

params.name: acl
params.description: An array of structs, one for each ACL grant.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: The S3 access key ID. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.accesskeyid` system property or environment variable.

params.name: secretAccessKey
params.description: The S3 secret access key. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.secretaccesskey` system property or environment variable.

params.name: host
params.description: The hostname of an S3-compatible provider, without `https://`. Defaults to Amazon AWS.

rustcfml.notes: Names the first two arguments `bucket` and `object`, and the secret key argument `secretKey`. When `mimeType` is omitted, detects it from the object key's extension. Doesn't list `timeout`.

examples.title: Write a string to a bucket
examples.description: Stores a text value under the given key.
